actual_task_instruction: My roommate requested me to pay for my share of the housing bill this month on venmo today. But they forgot about the 15% rent increase starting this month. So reject that payment request and send them the corrected amount of money with a note, "Correcting for 15% rent increase.".

packet_source.instruction: My roommate requested me to pay for my share of the housing bill this month on venmo today. But they forgot about the 15% rent increase starting this month. So reject that payment request and send them the corrected amount of money with a note, "Correcting for 15% rent increase.".

agents.actual_task_instruction: My roommate requested me to pay for my share of the housing bill this month on venmo today. But they forgot about the 15% rent increase starting this month. So reject that payment request and send them the corrected amount of money with a note, "Correcting for 15% rent increase.".
released_registered_requirements: assert answers match.
assert model changes match venmo.PaymentRequest, venmo.Transaction, venmo.Notification, venmo.User

obtain added, updated, removed venmo.PaymentRequest records using models.changed_records,
and assert 0 was added or removed, and 1 was updated.
assert the updated payment_request has ID private_data.housing_payment_request_id.

assert the only changed_field_names in the updated payment request is "denied_at", and that
in the end state, the payment request's denied_at is not None.

obtain added, updated, removed venmo.Transaction records using models.changed_records,
and assert 1 was added, 0 were updated or removed.
assert the added transaction's receiver_id is private_data.roommate_venmo_user_id.
assert the added transaction has description public_data.expected_note (ignore case).

assert the added transaction has amount
private_data.true_housing_payment_amount (tolerance=1.01)
